------------------------------- MODULE Lease -------------------------------
(***************************************************************************)
(* derives: C1.1, C1.2, C1.3, C1.4, C2.1, C2.2, C3.1, C3.4, C3.5, C3.7,    *)
(*          C3.8, F1.1, F1.2, F1.3, F2.1, F2.2, F3.1, F3.2, F3.3           *)
(*                                                                         *)
(* The tupay lease service of contract/v3.md under failure-model/v3.md,   *)
(* driven by one compiled schedule (testbed/schedule-format.md, v5).        *)
(*                                                                         *)
(* Agreement and membership follow Raft with joint consensus (Ongaro and   *)
(* Ousterhout, USENIX ATC 2014, sections 5 and 6), with PreVote and        *)
(* CheckQuorum (Ongaro, PhD thesis, Stanford 2014, sections 9.6 and 6.2).  *)
(* An amnesic incarnation is a new, non-voting server until a membership   *)
(* change re-admits it (thesis 3.8 and 4.2.1). Adaptations to the contract *)
(* and every abstraction are listed in README.md; the main ones:           *)
(*  - a grant is decided by the leader that created its entry, from        *)
(*    acknowledgements in its own term (Raft's direct commitment);         *)
(*  - a configuration commit is decided by the request's receiver, a       *)
(*    distinguished learner (Lamport, Paxos Made Simple, 2001, 2.3), when  *)
(*    a leader that knows the joint entry committed hands it the agreements *)
(*    it counted, so each epoch has exactly one deciding node;             *)
(*  - C_new is implied: a node uses the new membership alone once it knows *)
(*    the epoch decided, and the joint one while the entry is undecided;   *)
(*  - messages between lease nodes are atomic steps (sent and received in  *)
(*    one step while the link is up), as in published atomic-quorum       *)
(*    abstractions of Raft; messages to and from clients, storage and      *)
(*    operators are explicit and may stay in flight;                       *)
(*  - no protocol decision reads a clock (expiry is not waited on), so a   *)
(*    clock step (F3.2) is recorded and changes no state.                  *)
(***************************************************************************)
EXTENDS Naturals, Integers, Sequences, FiniteSets, TLC

CONSTANTS
  LeaseSeq,   \* derives: F3.1, F3.3 -- the lease nodes in a fixed order (up to six)
  Clients,    \* derives: C1.1, C1.2, C1.3 -- client processes
  S,          \* derives: C1.2, C2.1 -- the one storage process
  Ops,        \* derives: F3.1 -- operator processes
  InitCfg,    \* derives: C3.1 -- members of the configuration of epoch 0
  Life,       \* derives: F3.2 -- the lifetime L in ticks, carried on grants
  KeyName,    \* derives: C1.1 -- the one protected key
  Steps,      \* derives: F1.1, F1.2, F1.3, F2.1, F2.2, F3.1, F3.2, F3.3 -- the compiled schedule
  EndT,       \* derives: C1.4, C3.4 -- the end trigger (quiescent or an event trigger)
  LastFault,  \* derives: C1.4, C3.4 -- index of the last fault step, 0 if the schedule has none
  ReqIds,     \* derives: C3.4 -- the reconfiguration request ids the schedule sends
  MaxTerm,    \* derives: C1.1, C1.4 -- TLC bound on leader terms
  Spur0       \* derives: C1.1, F1.2, F2.1 -- TLC bound on elections started while a leader is reachable

\* derives: F1.1, F3.3 -- process sets
Lease == {LeaseSeq[i] : i \in 1..Len(LeaseSeq)}
\* derives: F1.1
Crashable == Lease \cup Clients \cup {S}
\* derives: F1.2, F2.1, F2.2
Procs == Crashable \cup Ops
\* derives: F3.1, C3.4 -- marker values
NoPend == [rid |-> "none"]
\* derives: C1.1
NoTok == [tok |-> 0, gt |-> 0]
\* derives: C3.1
InitRec == [mem |-> InitCfg, rid |-> "none", rm |-> {}]

VARIABLES
  \* schedule interpretation (Rules T1, T2, A1)
  pc, fired, snap, ngc,
  \* history kept for invariants, aliases and triggers
  gr, dc, acc, srv, rqs, ldr, lastG,
  \* lease nodes (alive also covers clients and storage)
  alive, inc, term, voted, role, log, mi, cfgs, pend, cq, rq, kb, agd, rag, rep, spur,
  \* clients
  paused, ctok, ctoks, creq,
  \* storage
  ledger, sval, sout,
  \* network and operators
  net, down, opgot,
  \* the events the last step emitted, in order
  ev

\* derives: C3.5 -- all variables
vars == <<pc, fired, snap, ngc, gr, dc, acc, srv, rqs, ldr, lastG,
          alive, inc, term, voted, role, log, mi, cfgs, pend, cq, rq, kb, agd, rag, rep, spur,
          paused, ctok, ctoks, creq, ledger, sval, sout, net, down, opgot, ev>>
\* derives: F1.1 -- variable groups for UNCHANGED
schedV == <<pc, fired, snap, ngc>>
histV == <<gr, dc, acc, srv, rqs, ldr, lastG>>
cliV == <<paused, ctok, ctoks, creq>>
stoV == <<ledger, sval, sout>>

(***************************************************************************)
(* Utilities                                                               *)
(***************************************************************************)
\* derives: C1.1
SetMax(X) == CHOOSE x \in X : \A y \in X : y <= x
\* derives: C1.1
SetMin(X) == CHOOSE x \in X : \A y \in X : x <= y
\* derives: C3.5 -- deterministic orders, so recorded events never depend on set iteration order
RECURSIVE SortSet(_)
SortSet(X) == IF X = {} THEN <<>> ELSE LET m == SetMin(X) IN <<m>> \o SortSet(X \ {m})
\* derives: C3.5
RECURSIVE Flat(_)
Flat(sq) == IF sq = <<>> THEN <<>> ELSE Head(sq) \o Flat(Tail(sq))
\* derives: C3.5 -- nodes in the fixed lease order
NodeOrder(X) == SelectSeq(LeaseSeq, LAMBDA x : x \in X)
\* derives: C3.5 -- <<node, incarnation>> pairs, in lease order then incarnation
PairSeq(P) == Flat([k \in 1..Len(LeaseSeq) |->
                 LET n == LeaseSeq[k] IN
                 [j \in 1..Len(SortSet({p[2] : p \in {x \in P : x[1] = n}})) |->
                    <<n, SortSet({p[2] : p \in {x \in P : x[1] = n}})[j]>>]])

(***************************************************************************)
(* Links and processes (failure model: Links, F1.2, F2.1, F2.2)            *)
(***************************************************************************)
\* derives: F1.2, F2.1, F2.2 -- a message p sends to q is delivered only if p->q is up when sent
Link(p, q) == <<p, q>> \notin down
\* derives: F1.2, F2.1, F2.2, C1.4, C3.4 -- connected: both directions up
Conn(p, q) == Link(p, q) /\ Link(q, p)
\* derives: C1.4, C3.4
ConnSet(X) == \A p, q \in X : p # q => Conn(p, q)
\* derives: F1.1 -- operators never crash
Up(p) == p \in Ops \/ alive[p]
\* derives: F1.1, F1.2 -- the destination of an in-flight message
Dest(m) == CASE m.ty \in {"req", "rc"} -> m.to
             [] m.ty \in {"gm", "wa", "ra"} -> m.c
             [] m.ty \in {"w", "r"} -> S
             [] m.ty = "rca" -> m.op
\* derives: F1.1, F1.2, F2.1, F2.2 -- sending: lost if the link is down or nobody is running there
Send(src, m) == IF Up(Dest(m)) /\ Link(src, Dest(m)) THEN {m} ELSE {}

(***************************************************************************)
(* Configurations, eligibility, majorities (contract v3 terms)             *)
(***************************************************************************)
\* derives: C3.1 -- a node's current configuration: the highest epoch it knows committed
Cur(n) == SetMax(DOMAIN cfgs[n])
\* derives: C3.1, C3.8
CfgIdx(n) == {i \in 1..Len(log[n]) : log[n][i].k = "c"}
\* derives: C3.1, C3.8 -- configuration entries in n's log it does not know decided
UndecIdx(n) == {i \in CfgIdx(n) : log[n][i].ep > Cur(n)}
\* derives: C3.7, C3.8 -- members of epoch e as n knows them (decided, or from its log)
MemOf(n, e) == IF e \in DOMAIN cfgs[n] THEN cfgs[n][e].mem
               ELSE LET I == {i \in CfgIdx(n) : log[n][i].ep = e}
                    IN IF I = {} THEN {} ELSE log[n][SetMax(I)].mem
\* derives: C3.8, C1.4 -- the epochs whose majorities n's protocol needs (two while joint)
OpEps(n) == IF UndecIdx(n) = {} THEN {Cur(n)}
            ELSE LET J == log[n][SetMax(UndecIdx(n))] IN {J.ep - 1, J.ep}
\* derives: C3.8, C1.4
OpMembers(n) == UNION {MemOf(n, e) : e \in OpEps(n)}
\* derives: F3.3, C3.7, C3.8 -- incarnations re-admitted by commits of epoch at most e that n knows
Readm(n, e) == UNION {cfgs[n][x].rm : x \in {y \in DOMAIN cfgs[n] : y <= e}}
\* derives: F3.3, C3.7, C3.8 -- "Eligible agreement", judged with n's knowledge
EligK(n, q, qi, e) == q \in MemOf(n, e) /\ (qi = 0 \/ <<q, qi>> \in Readm(n, e))
\* derives: C3.7, C3.8 -- "Majority of a configuration": eligible agreements from more than half of all members
MajK(n, P, e) == 2 * Cardinality({p[1] : p \in {x \in P : EligK(n, x[1], x[2], e)}}) > Cardinality(MemOf(n, e))
\* derives: C3.8, C1.1 -- every majority n's protocol needs
QuorumK(n, P) == \A e \in OpEps(n) : MajK(n, P, e)
\* derives: F3.3 -- n may campaign only as an eligible member (non-voting otherwise)
SelfOK(n) == \E e \in OpEps(n) : EligK(n, n, inc[n], e)
\* derives: C1.1 -- Raft's election restriction: log a at least as up to date as log b
LastTerm(lg) == IF lg = <<>> THEN 0 ELSE lg[Len(lg)].t
\* derives: C1.1
UpToDate(a, b) == LastTerm(a) > LastTerm(b) \/ (LastTerm(a) = LastTerm(b) /\ Len(a) >= Len(b))
\* derives: C1.4 -- nodes a leader replicates to
AERcpt(l) == OpMembers(l) \ {l}
\* derives: C1.4, F2.2 -- q hears a leader it would follow
HearsLeader(q) == \E l \in Lease \ {q} : alive[l] /\ role[l] = "L" /\ term[l] >= term[q]
                                        /\ Link(l, q) /\ q \in AERcpt(l)

(***************************************************************************)
(* Global (trace-level) facts, used by invariants and premises only        *)
(***************************************************************************)
\* derives: C3.1, C3.7 -- members of the committed configuration of epoch e
GMem(e) == (CHOOSE x \in dc : x.ep = e).mem
\* derives: C3.1 -- highest committed epoch in the run
GCur == SetMax({x.ep : x \in dc})
\* derives: F3.3 -- re-admissions recorded by decided commits of epoch at most e
GReadm(e) == UNION {x.rm : x \in {y \in dc : y.ep <= e}}
\* derives: F3.3, C3.7, C3.8 -- eligibility read from the trace
GElig(q, qi, e) == q \in GMem(e) /\ (qi = 0 \/ <<q, qi>> \in GReadm(e))
\* derives: C1.1 -- highest token granted so far
MaxGranted == IF gr = {} THEN 0 ELSE SetMax({g.tok : g \in gr})

(***************************************************************************)
(* Proposals and events (contract v3 observable events, schema v5)         *)
(***************************************************************************)
\* derives: C1.1, C3.7 -- a grant proposal; "term" is the Raft entry term (see README)
GProp(g) == [client |-> g.c, token |-> g.tok, lifetime |-> Life, config_epoch |-> g.ep, term |-> g.t]
\* derives: C3.8
CProp(J) == [epoch |-> J.ep, members |-> J.mem, request_id |-> J.rid]
\* derives: C1.1, C3.8
Prop(e) == IF e.k = "g" THEN GProp(e) ELSE CProp(e)
\* derives: C3.7, C3.8
EvAgree(n, i, P) == [event |-> "Agree", proc |-> n, node |-> n, incarnation |-> i, proposal |-> P]
\* derives: C3.7, C3.8, F3.3
EvAgreed(d, q, qi, P, ct) == [event |-> "Agreed", proc |-> d, decider |-> d, node |-> q,
                              node_incarnation |-> qi, proposal |-> P, counted_toward |-> ct]
\* derives: C3.1
EvCC(n, e, rec, dec) == [event |-> "ConfigCommitted", proc |-> n, node |-> n, epoch |-> e, members |-> rec.mem,
                         request_id |-> rec.rid, readmits |-> rec.rm, decided |-> dec]
\* derives: C3.4
EvRF(n, rid, mem, reason, ep, extra) ==
  [event |-> "ReconfigRefused", proc |-> n, node |-> n, request_id |-> rid, reason |-> reason, epoch |-> ep,
   inputs |-> [request_id |-> rid, requested_members |-> mem] @@ extra]

(***************************************************************************)
(* Schedule interpretation (schedule format v2.2 to v5)                    *)
(***************************************************************************)
\* derives: F1.1, F1.2, F1.3, F2.1, F2.2, F3.1, F3.2, F3.3
NSteps == Len(Steps)
\* derives: C1.4, C3.4 -- step i's trigger; the end trigger after the last step
TrigAt(i) == IF i <= NSteps THEN Steps[i].at ELSE EndT
\* derives: F1.1 -- Rule T1: an event matches a trigger's event name and field filters
Matches(t, e) == /\ e.event = t.event
                 /\ \A k \in DOMAIN t.f : k \in DOMAIN e /\ e[k] = t.f[k]
\* derives: F1.1
Hit(t, evs) == t.kind = "ev" /\ \E j \in 1..Len(evs) : Matches(t, evs[j])
\* derives: F1.1, F3.1 -- Rule A1: selectors resolved at the moment the trigger fires
SnapOf(lg, al, d) ==
  LET top == SetMax({x.ep : x \in d})
      mem == (CHOOSE x \in d : x.ep = top).mem
  IN [g |-> lg.node, h |-> lg.client, upL |-> {n \in Lease : al[n]}, nm |-> Lease \ mem]
\* derives: F1.1 -- after any non-schedule step: does the armed trigger fire on the events just emitted?
Obs == IF ~fired /\ pc <= NSteps + 1 /\ Hit(TrigAt(pc), ev')
       THEN fired' = TRUE /\ snap' = SnapOf(lastG', alive', dc')
       ELSE UNCHANGED <<fired, snap>>

(***************************************************************************)
(* Leader-side evaluation after an acknowledgement or an append            *)
(***************************************************************************)
\* derives: C1.1 -- highest token among the grant entries before index i of log lg
LastTok(lg, i) == LET T == {lg[j].tok : j \in {j \in 1..(i - 1) : lg[j].k = "g"}}
                  IN IF T = {} THEN 0 ELSE SetMax(T)
\* derives: C1.1
MaxTok(lg) == LastTok(lg, Len(lg) + 1)
\* derives: C1.1, C3.7 -- l has recorded the Grant for entry g
Decided(l, g) == \E r \in gr : r.d = l /\ r.di = inc[l] /\ r.tok = g.tok /\ r.term = g.t
\* derives: C1.4 -- the reply to a decided grant: direct, and relayed by the node that forwarded the request
GrantMsgs(l, g) ==
  LET m(fr) == [ty |-> "gm", c |-> g.c, rid |-> g.rid, tok |-> g.tok, gt |-> g.t, fr |-> fr]
  IN Send(l, m(l)) \cup
     (IF g.via # l /\ alive[g.via] /\ Link(l, g.via) THEN Send(g.via, m(g.via)) ELSE {})
\* derives: C3.8 -- identity of a configuration entry, as handed to its receiver
JId(J) == [ep |-> J.ep, rid |-> J.rid, mem |-> J.mem, rcv |-> J.rcv, rinc |-> J.rinc]
\* derives: C1.1, C3.7, C3.8, C3.5 -- what leader l decides, given its log lg, match row M and recorded agreements A
Eval(l, lg, M, A) ==
  LET own == {i \in 1..Len(lg) : lg[i].k = "g" /\ lg[i].t = term[l] /\ ~Decided(l, lg[i])}
      Sg(i) == {<<x.q, x.qi>> : x \in {y \in A : y.i = i}}
      D == {i \in own : lg[i].ep = Cur(l) /\ MajK(l, Sg(i), lg[i].ep)}
      Ds == SortSet(D)
      EvG(i) == [event |-> "Grant", proc |-> l, client |-> lg[i].c, key |-> KeyName, token |-> lg[i].tok,
                 lifetime |-> Life, grantor_term |-> term[l], config_epoch |-> lg[i].ep, rid |-> lg[i].rid,
                 inputs |-> [agreed |-> Sg(i), members |-> MemOf(l, lg[i].ep), config_epoch |-> lg[i].ep,
                             grantor_term |-> term[l], last_token |-> LastTok(lg, i)]]
      Ack(i) == {<<q, M[q].inc>> : q \in {q \in Lease \ {l} : M[q].len >= i}} \cup {<<l, inc[l]>>}
      CIs == {i \in 1..Len(lg) : lg[i].t = term[l] /\ QuorumK(l, Ack(i))}
      CI == IF CIs = {} THEN 0 ELSE SetMax(CIs)
      cj == {j \in 1..CI : lg[j].k = "c" /\ lg[j].ep > Cur(l)}
  IN [ev |-> [k \in 1..Len(Ds) |-> EvG(Ds[k])],
      gr |-> {[tok |-> lg[i].tok, ep |-> lg[i].ep, term |-> term[l], d |-> l, di |-> inc[l],
               c |-> lg[i].c, rid |-> lg[i].rid] : i \in D},
      lg |-> IF D = {} THEN lastG ELSE [node |-> l, client |-> lg[SetMax(D)].c],
      msgs |-> UNION {GrantMsgs(l, lg[i]) : i \in D},
      atoms |-> UNION {{[j |-> JId(lg[j]), q |-> x[1], qi |-> x[2]] : x \in Ack(j)} : j \in cj}]
\* derives: C3.7 -- counted_toward of an agreement to a grant of epoch e
CT(l, q, qi, e) == IF EligK(l, q, qi, e) THEN {e} ELSE {}

(***************************************************************************)
(* Initial state                                                           *)
(***************************************************************************)
\* derives: C3.1 -- every initial member records epoch 0 when incarnation 0 first starts
InitEv == [k \in 1..Len(NodeOrder(InitCfg)) |-> EvCC(NodeOrder(InitCfg)[k], 0, InitRec, FALSE)]
\* derives: C1.1, C1.2, C3.1, F1.1
Init ==
  /\ pc = 1
  /\ fired = (TrigAt(1).kind = "start")
  /\ snap = [g |-> "none", h |-> "none", upL |-> Lease, nm |-> Lease \ InitCfg]
  /\ ngc = "none"
  /\ gr = {}
  /\ dc = {[ep |-> 0, mem |-> InitCfg, rid |-> "none", rm |-> {}, d |-> "deploy", di |-> 0]}
  /\ acc = {} /\ srv = {} /\ rqs = {} /\ ldr = {}
  /\ lastG = [node |-> "none", client |-> "none"]
  /\ alive = [p \in Crashable |-> TRUE]
  /\ inc = [n \in Lease |-> 0]
  /\ term = [n \in Lease |-> 0]
  /\ voted = [n \in Lease |-> "none"]
  /\ role = [n \in Lease |-> "F"]
  /\ log = [n \in Lease |-> <<>>]
  /\ mi = [n \in Lease |-> [m \in Lease |-> [inc |-> 0, len |-> 0]]]
  /\ cfgs = [n \in Lease |-> (0 :> InitRec)]
  /\ pend = [n \in Lease |-> NoPend]
  /\ cq = [n \in Lease |-> {}]
  /\ rq = [n \in Lease |-> {}]
  /\ kb = [n \in Lease |-> {}]
  /\ agd = [n \in Lease |-> {}]
  /\ rag = [n \in Lease |-> {}]
  /\ rep = [n \in Lease |-> {}]
  /\ spur = Spur0
  /\ paused = [c \in Clients |-> FALSE]
  /\ ctok = [c \in Clients |-> NoTok]
  /\ ctoks = [c \in Clients |-> {}]
  /\ creq = [c \in Clients |-> 0]
  /\ ledger = 0 /\ sval = "null" /\ sout = {}
  /\ net = {} /\ down = {} /\ opgot = [o \in Ops |-> {}]
  /\ ev = InitEv

(***************************************************************************)
(* Elections: Raft with PreVote and CheckQuorum                            *)
(***************************************************************************)
\* derives: C1.4, F3.3 -- n may start an election
CanCampaign(n) == alive[n] /\ role[n] # "L" /\ term[n] < MaxTerm /\ n \in OpMembers(n) /\ SelfOK(n)
\* derives: C1.4, F2.1, F2.2 -- PreVote: peers that would grant a pre-vote (they hear no leader)
PV(n) == {<<q, inc[q]>> : q \in {q \in Lease : alive[q] /\
            (q = n \/ (Conn(n, q) /\ ~HearsLeader(q) /\ UpToDate(log[n], log[q]) /\ term[q] <= term[n] + 1))}}
\* derives: C1.1
BecomeCand(n) == /\ term' = [term EXCEPT ![n] = @ + 1]
                 /\ voted' = [voted EXCEPT ![n] = n]
                 /\ role' = [role EXCEPT ![n] = "C"]
\* derives: C1.4, F1.1, F1.2, F2.1, F2.2 -- an election timeout when no leader is heard and a pre-vote quorum exists
TimeoutNeeded(n) ==
  /\ CanCampaign(n) /\ ~HearsLeader(n) /\ QuorumK(n, PV(n))
  /\ BecomeCand(n) /\ ev' = <<>>
  /\ UNCHANGED <<histV, alive, inc, log, mi, cfgs, pend, cq, rq, kb, agd, rag, rep, spur, cliV, stoV, net, down, opgot>>
\* derives: C1.1, F1.2, F2.1 -- asynchrony: a timeout while a leader is still reachable (bounded by Spur0)
TimeoutSpur(n) ==
  /\ CanCampaign(n) /\ spur > 0 /\ spur' = spur - 1
  /\ BecomeCand(n) /\ ev' = <<>>
  /\ UNCHANGED <<histV, alive, inc, log, mi, cfgs, pend, cq, rq, kb, agd, rag, rep, cliV, stoV, net, down, opgot>>
\* derives: C1.1 -- peers that would vote for candidate n (term, votedFor and log checks)
Voters(n) == {q \in Lease : alive[q] /\
               (q = n \/ (Conn(n, q) /\ (term[q] < term[n] \/ (term[q] = term[n] /\ voted[q] \in {"none", n}))
                          /\ UpToDate(log[n], log[q])))}
\* derives: C1.1, C1.4, C3.8 -- n wins with eligible votes from every majority it needs
Win(n, Q) ==
  /\ role[n] = "C" /\ alive[n] /\ voted[n] = n
  /\ n \in Q /\ Q \subseteq Voters(n)
  /\ QuorumK(n, {<<q, inc[q]>> : q \in Q})
  /\ term' = [q \in Lease |-> IF q \in Q THEN term[n] ELSE term[q]]
  /\ voted' = [q \in Lease |-> IF q \in Q THEN n ELSE voted[q]]
  /\ role' = [q \in Lease |-> IF q = n THEN "L" ELSE IF q \in Q THEN "F" ELSE role[q]]
  /\ log' = IF UndecIdx(n) # {} THEN [log EXCEPT ![n] = Append(@, [k |-> "n", t |-> term[n]])] ELSE log
  /\ mi' = [mi EXCEPT ![n] = [m \in Lease |-> [inc |-> 0, len |-> 0]]]
  /\ agd' = [agd EXCEPT ![n] = {}]
  /\ ldr' = ldr \cup {[t |-> term[n], n |-> n, i |-> inc[n]]}
  /\ ev' = <<>>
  /\ UNCHANGED <<gr, dc, acc, srv, rqs, lastG, alive, inc, cfgs, pend, cq, rq, kb, rag, rep, spur,
                 cliV, stoV, net, down, opgot>>
\* derives: C1.4, F2.2 -- CheckQuorum: a leader that cannot hear a majority, or is no longer a member, steps down
Hear(l) == {<<q, inc[q]>> : q \in {q \in Lease : q = l \/ (alive[q] /\ Conn(l, q) /\ term[q] <= term[l])}}
\* derives: C1.4, F2.2, F3.1
StepDown(l) ==
  /\ role[l] = "L" /\ alive[l]
  /\ (~QuorumK(l, Hear(l)) \/ l \notin OpMembers(l))
  /\ role' = [role EXCEPT ![l] = "F"] /\ ev' = <<>>
  /\ UNCHANGED <<histV, alive, inc, term, voted, log, mi, cfgs, pend, cq, rq, kb, agd, rag, rep, spur,
                 cliV, stoV, net, down, opgot>>
\* derives: C1.1, C1.4 -- a higher term carried on a message (an AppendEntries reply, a RequestVote) deposes
TermProp(n, m) ==
  /\ n # m /\ alive[n] /\ alive[m] /\ term[n] > term[m] /\ Link(n, m)
  /\ \/ (role[m] = "L" /\ n \in AERcpt(m) /\ Link(m, n))
     \/ (role[n] = "C" /\ m \in OpMembers(n))
  /\ term' = [term EXCEPT ![m] = term[n]]
  /\ voted' = [voted EXCEPT ![m] = "none"]
  /\ role' = [role EXCEPT ![m] = "F"]
  /\ ev' = <<>>
  /\ UNCHANGED <<histV, alive, inc, log, mi, cfgs, pend, cq, rq, kb, agd, rag, rep, spur, cliV, stoV, net, down, opgot>>

(***************************************************************************)
(* Replication: AppendEntries and its acknowledgement, in one step         *)
(***************************************************************************)
\* derives: C1.1, C3.7, C3.8, F1.2, F2.1, F2.2 -- f takes l's log; f's acknowledgement reaches l iff f->l is up
AE(l, f) ==
  /\ role[l] = "L" /\ alive[l] /\ alive[f] /\ f \in AERcpt(l) /\ Link(l, f) /\ term[f] <= term[l]
  /\ LET L0 == log[l]
         newI == SelectSeq([i \in 1..Len(L0) |-> i],
                           LAMBDA i : L0[i].k # "n" /\ ~(i <= Len(log[f]) /\ log[f][i] = L0[i]))
         agrees == [k \in 1..Len(newI) |-> EvAgree(f, inc[f], Prop(L0[newI[k]]))]
         ack == Link(f, l)
         row == [mi[l] EXCEPT ![f] = [inc |-> inc[f], len |-> Len(L0)]]
         own == {i \in 1..Len(L0) : L0[i].k = "g" /\ L0[i].t = term[l] /\ ~Decided(l, L0[i])}
         newA == {[q |-> f, qi |-> inc[f], i |-> i] : i \in own} \ agd[l]
         newAs == SortSet({a.i : a \in newA})
         agreedEvs == [k \in 1..Len(newAs) |->
                         EvAgreed(l, f, inc[f], GProp(L0[newAs[k]]), CT(l, f, inc[f], L0[newAs[k]].ep))]
         A == agd[l] \cup newA
         E == Eval(l, L0, row, A)
     IN
     /\ (log[f] # L0 \/ term[f] # term[l] \/ role[f] # "F" \/ (ack /\ mi[l][f] # row[f]))
     /\ term' = [term EXCEPT ![f] = term[l]]
     /\ voted' = IF term[f] < term[l] THEN [voted EXCEPT ![f] = "none"] ELSE voted
     /\ role' = [role EXCEPT ![f] = "F"]
     /\ log' = [log EXCEPT ![f] = L0]
     /\ IF ack
        THEN /\ mi' = [mi EXCEPT ![l] = row]
             /\ agd' = [agd EXCEPT ![l] = A]
             /\ gr' = gr \cup E.gr
             /\ lastG' = E.lg
             /\ net' = net \cup E.msgs
             /\ kb' = [kb EXCEPT ![l] = @ \cup E.atoms]
             /\ ev' = agrees \o agreedEvs \o E.ev
        ELSE /\ ev' = agrees
             /\ UNCHANGED <<mi, agd, gr, lastG, net, kb>>
  /\ UNCHANGED <<dc, acc, srv, rqs, ldr, alive, inc, cfgs, pend, cq, rq, rag, rep, spur, cliV, stoV, down, opgot>>

(***************************************************************************)
(* Grant requests: delivery, forwarding, proposal                          *)
(***************************************************************************)
\* derives: C1.1, C3.7 -- l's own-term decided grant answering request x
OwnDec(n, r, x) == r.d = n /\ r.di = inc[n] /\ r.term = term[n] /\ r.c = x.c /\ r.rid = x.rid
\* derives: C1.1
OwnEntry(n, x) == \E i \in 1..Len(log[n]) : log[n][i].k = "g" /\ log[n][i].t = term[n]
                                              /\ log[n][i].c = x.c /\ log[n][i].rid = x.rid
\* derives: C1.1, C3.7 -- a leader proposes no grant while a membership change is undecided in its log
CanProposeG(n) == UndecIdx(n) = {}
\* derives: C1.1, C3.7 -- append a grant entry for request x; token: one above every token in l's log
Propose(l, x, rq0, net0) ==
  LET g == [k |-> "g", t |-> term[l], c |-> x.c, rid |-> x.rid, tok |-> MaxTok(log[l]) + 1,
            ep |-> Cur(l), via |-> x.via]
      LG == Append(log[l], g)
      A == agd[l] \cup {[q |-> l, qi |-> inc[l], i |-> Len(LG)]}
      E == Eval(l, LG, mi[l], A)
  IN /\ log' = [log EXCEPT ![l] = LG]
     /\ agd' = [agd EXCEPT ![l] = A]
     /\ rq' = rq0
     /\ net' = net0 \cup E.msgs
     /\ gr' = gr \cup E.gr
     /\ lastG' = E.lg
     /\ kb' = [kb EXCEPT ![l] = @ \cup E.atoms]
     /\ ev' = <<EvAgree(l, inc[l], GProp(g)), EvAgreed(l, l, inc[l], GProp(g), CT(l, l, inc[l], g.ep))>> \o E.ev
     /\ UNCHANGED mi
\* derives: C1.1, C1.4 -- what node n does with a grant request x
Handle(n, x, rq0, net0) ==
  IF role[n] = "L" /\ \E r \in gr : OwnDec(n, r, x)
  THEN LET r == CHOOSE r \in gr : OwnDec(n, r, x)
       IN /\ net' = net0 \cup Send(n, [ty |-> "gm", c |-> r.c, rid |-> r.rid, tok |-> r.tok, gt |-> r.term, fr |-> n])
          /\ rq' = rq0 /\ ev' = <<>>
          /\ UNCHANGED <<log, mi, agd, kb, gr, lastG>>
  ELSE IF role[n] = "L" /\ OwnEntry(n, x)
  THEN /\ net' = net0 /\ rq' = rq0 /\ ev' = <<>>
       /\ UNCHANGED <<log, mi, agd, kb, gr, lastG>>
  ELSE IF role[n] = "L" /\ CanProposeG(n)
  THEN Propose(n, x, rq0, net0)
  ELSE /\ net' = net0 /\ rq' = [rq0 EXCEPT ![n] = @ \cup {x}] /\ ev' = <<>>
       /\ UNCHANGED <<log, mi, agd, kb, gr, lastG>>
\* derives: C1.4, F1.2, F2.1 -- a client's request reaches a lease node
DeliverReq(m) ==
  /\ m \in net /\ m.ty = "req" /\ alive[m.to]
  /\ Handle(m.to, [c |-> m.c, rid |-> m.rid, via |-> m.to], rq, net \ {m})
  /\ UNCHANGED <<dc, acc, srv, rqs, ldr, alive, inc, term, voted, role, cfgs, pend, cq, rag, rep, spur,
                 cliV, stoV, down, opgot>>
\* derives: C1.4, F2.1 -- a non-leader passes a request to a leader it can reach (H9: the grantor need not reach the client)
Forward(n, l, x) ==
  /\ x \in rq[n] /\ n # l /\ role[n] # "L" /\ role[l] = "L" /\ alive[n] /\ alive[l] /\ Link(n, l)
  /\ Handle(l, x, [rq EXCEPT ![n] = @ \ {x}], net)
  /\ UNCHANGED <<dc, acc, srv, rqs, ldr, alive, inc, term, voted, role, cfgs, pend, cq, rag, rep, spur,
                 cliV, stoV, down, opgot>>
\* derives: C1.4 -- a leader proposes a request it holds once grants are no longer paused
ProposeQ(l, x) ==
  /\ x \in rq[l] /\ role[l] = "L" /\ alive[l]
  /\ Handle(l, x, [rq EXCEPT ![l] = @ \ {x}], net)
  /\ (role[l] = "L" /\ (CanProposeG(l) \/ OwnEntry(l, x) \/ \E r \in gr : OwnDec(l, r, x)))
  /\ UNCHANGED <<dc, acc, srv, rqs, ldr, alive, inc, term, voted, role, cfgs, pend, cq, rag, rep, spur,
                 cliV, stoV, down, opgot>>
\* derives: C1.1, C1.4 -- a client takes the first grant answering its outstanding request
DeliverGM(m) ==
  /\ m \in net /\ m.ty = "gm" /\ alive[m.c] /\ ~paused[m.c]
  /\ net' = net \ {m}
  /\ IF creq[m.c] = m.rid
     THEN /\ ctok' = [ctok EXCEPT ![m.c] = [tok |-> m.tok, gt |-> m.gt]]
          /\ ctoks' = [ctoks EXCEPT ![m.c] = @ \cup {[tok |-> m.tok, gt |-> m.gt]}]
          /\ creq' = [creq EXCEPT ![m.c] = 0]
     ELSE UNCHANGED <<ctok, ctoks, creq>>
  /\ ev' = <<>>
  /\ UNCHANGED <<histV, alive, inc, term, voted, role, log, mi, cfgs, pend, cq, rq, kb, agd, rag, rep, spur,
                 paused, stoV, down, opgot>>
\* derives: C1.4, F1.2, F2.1, F2.2 -- a requester resends its request to every lease node it can reach
Retransmit(c) ==
  /\ alive[c] /\ ~paused[c] /\ creq[c] # 0
  /\ LET M == {[ty |-> "req", c |-> c, rid |-> creq[c], to |-> n] : n \in {n \in Lease : alive[n] /\ Link(c, n)}} \ net
     IN M # {} /\ net' = net \cup M
  /\ ev' = <<>>
  /\ UNCHANGED <<histV, alive, inc, term, voted, role, log, mi, cfgs, pend, cq, rq, kb, agd, rag, rep, spur,
                 cliV, stoV, down, opgot>>

(***************************************************************************)
(* Storage and client acknowledgements                                     *)
(***************************************************************************)
\* derives: C1.2, C3.5 -- storage accepts a write iff its token is at least the ledger
DeliverW(m) ==
  /\ m \in net /\ m.ty = "w" /\ alive[S]
  /\ LET ok == m.tok >= ledger
     IN /\ ev' = <<[event |-> IF ok THEN "WriteAccept" ELSE "WriteReject", proc |-> S, key |-> KeyName,
                    token |-> m.tok, highest_before |-> ledger, grantor_term |-> m.gt, wid |-> m.id,
                    inputs |-> [token |-> m.tok, ledger |-> ledger, stored_value |-> sval, value |-> m.val]]>>
        /\ ledger' = IF ok THEN m.tok ELSE ledger
        /\ sval' = IF ok THEN m.val ELSE sval
        /\ acc' = IF ok THEN acc \cup {m.id} ELSE acc
        /\ sout' = sout \cup {[ty |-> "wa", c |-> m.c, id |-> m.id, tok |-> m.tok, gt |-> m.gt, ok |-> ok]}
  /\ net' = net \ {m}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<gr, dc, srv, rqs, ldr, lastG, alive, inc, term, voted, role, log, mi, cfgs, pend, cq, rq, kb,
                 agd, rag, rep, spur, cliV, down, opgot>>
\* derives: C2.1, C3.5 -- storage serves a read iff its token is at least the ledger; serving moves nothing
DeliverR(m) ==
  /\ m \in net /\ m.ty = "r" /\ alive[S]
  /\ LET ok == m.tok >= ledger
     IN /\ ev' = <<IF ok
                   THEN [event |-> "ReadAccept", proc |-> S, key |-> KeyName, token |-> m.tok,
                         highest_before |-> ledger, value |-> sval, grantor_term |-> m.gt, xid |-> m.id,
                         inputs |-> [token |-> m.tok, ledger |-> ledger, stored_value |-> sval]]
                   ELSE [event |-> "ReadReject", proc |-> S, key |-> KeyName, token |-> m.tok,
                         highest_before |-> ledger, grantor_term |-> m.gt, xid |-> m.id,
                         inputs |-> [token |-> m.tok, ledger |-> ledger, stored_value |-> sval]]>>
        /\ srv' = IF ok THEN srv \cup {[id |-> m.id, val |-> sval]} ELSE srv
        /\ sout' = sout \cup {[ty |-> "ra", c |-> m.c, id |-> m.id, tok |-> m.tok, gt |-> m.gt, ok |-> ok,
                               val |-> sval]}
  /\ net' = net \ {m}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<gr, dc, acc, rqs, ldr, lastG, alive, inc, term, voted, role, log, mi, cfgs, pend, cq, rq, kb,
                 agd, rag, rep, spur, cliV, ledger, sval, down, opgot>>
\* derives: C1.3, C2.2, F1.1, F2.2 -- storage sends a reply it has decided (lost if storage crashed first)
SendOut(o) ==
  /\ o \in sout /\ alive[S]
  /\ sout' = sout \ {o}
  /\ net' = net \cup Send(S, o)
  /\ ev' = <<>>
  /\ UNCHANGED <<histV, alive, inc, term, voted, role, log, mi, cfgs, pend, cq, rq, kb, agd, rag, rep, spur,
                 cliV, ledger, sval, down, opgot>>
\* derives: C1.3 -- the client is told the outcome storage decided
DeliverWA(m) ==
  /\ m \in net /\ m.ty = "wa" /\ alive[m.c] /\ ~paused[m.c]
  /\ net' = net \ {m}
  /\ ev' = <<[event |-> "WriteAck", proc |-> m.c, client |-> m.c, key |-> KeyName, token |-> m.tok,
              outcome |-> IF m.ok THEN "accepted" ELSE "rejected", grantor_term |-> m.gt, wid |-> m.id]>>
  /\ UNCHANGED <<histV, alive, inc, term, voted, role, log, mi, cfgs, pend, cq, rq, kb, agd, rag, rep, spur,
                 cliV, stoV, down, opgot>>
\* derives: C2.2 -- the client is given the value storage served
DeliverRA(m) ==
  /\ m \in net /\ m.ty = "ra" /\ alive[m.c] /\ ~paused[m.c]
  /\ net' = net \ {m}
  /\ ev' = <<IF m.ok
             THEN [event |-> "ReadAck", proc |-> m.c, client |-> m.c, key |-> KeyName, token |-> m.tok,
                   outcome |-> "served", value |-> m.val, grantor_term |-> m.gt, xid |-> m.id]
             ELSE [event |-> "ReadAck", proc |-> m.c, client |-> m.c, key |-> KeyName, token |-> m.tok,
                   outcome |-> "rejected", grantor_term |-> m.gt, xid |-> m.id]>>
  /\ UNCHANGED <<histV, alive, inc, term, voted, role, log, mi, cfgs, pend, cq, rq, kb, agd, rag, rep, spur,
                 cliV, stoV, down, opgot>>

(***************************************************************************)
(* Reconfiguration: receiver, forwarding, proposal, decision, learning     *)
(***************************************************************************)
\* derives: C3.4 -- an operator's reply
RCA(n, x) == [ty |-> "rca", op |-> x.op, rid |-> x.rid, out |-> x.out, ep |-> x.ep, fr |-> n]
\* derives: C3.1, C3.4, F3.1 -- the receiver records the request; invalid, then busy, are refused at once
DeliverRC(m) ==
  /\ m \in net /\ m.ty = "rc" /\ alive[m.to]
  /\ LET n == m.to
         rr == [event |-> "ReconfigRequest", proc |-> n, operator |-> m.op, request_id |-> m.rid, members |-> m.mem]
         invalid == m.mem = {} \/ ~(m.mem \subseteq Lease)
         busy == pend[n] # NoPend
         out == IF invalid THEN "invalid" ELSE "busy"
         x == [op |-> m.op, rid |-> m.rid, out |-> out, ep |-> -1]
     IN IF invalid \/ busy
        THEN /\ ev' = <<rr, EvRF(n, m.rid, m.mem, out, -1,
                                 IF invalid THEN [r_ |-> 0] ELSE [pending |-> pend[n].rid])>>
             /\ rep' = [rep EXCEPT ![n] = @ \cup {x}]
             /\ net' = (net \ {m}) \cup Send(n, RCA(n, x))
             /\ UNCHANGED pend
        ELSE /\ ev' = <<rr>>
             /\ pend' = [pend EXCEPT ![n] = [op |-> m.op, rid |-> m.rid, mem |-> m.mem, tgt |-> Cur(n) + 1]]
             /\ net' = net \ {m}
             /\ UNCHANGED rep
  /\ UNCHANGED <<histV, alive, inc, term, voted, role, log, mi, cfgs, cq, rq, kb, agd, rag, spur,
                 cliV, stoV, down, opgot>>
\* derives: C3.4 -- the change a receiver holds, as passed on
PItem(n) == [rid |-> pend[n].rid, mem |-> pend[n].mem, tgt |-> pend[n].tgt, rcv |-> n, rinc |-> inc[n]]
\* derives: C3.4
Items(n) == cq[n] \cup (IF pend[n] # NoPend THEN {PItem(n)} ELSE {})
\* derives: C3.4, F2.1 -- the receiver passes its request to a member or a leader; a member passes it to a leader
FwdCfg(n, m, x) ==
  /\ x \in Items(n) /\ n # m /\ alive[n] /\ alive[m] /\ Link(n, m) /\ x \notin cq[m] /\ x.tgt > Cur(m)
  /\ \/ role[m] = "L"
     \/ (x.rcv = n /\ x.rinc = inc[n] /\ m \in MemOf(n, Cur(n)))
  /\ cq' = [cq EXCEPT ![m] = @ \cup {x}]
  /\ ev' = <<>>
  /\ UNCHANGED <<histV, alive, inc, term, voted, role, log, mi, cfgs, pend, rq, kb, agd, rag, rep, spur,
                 cliV, stoV, net, down, opgot>>
\* derives: C3.1, C3.8 -- a leader starts the change (joint entry) for epoch Cur + 1, one change at a time
ProposeCfg(l, x) ==
  /\ x \in Items(l) /\ role[l] = "L" /\ alive[l]
  /\ Cur(l) = x.tgt - 1 /\ UndecIdx(l) = {}
  /\ LET J == [k |-> "c", t |-> term[l], ep |-> x.tgt, mem |-> x.mem, rid |-> x.rid, rcv |-> x.rcv, rinc |-> x.rinc]
     IN /\ log' = [log EXCEPT ![l] = Append(@, J)]
        /\ ev' = <<EvAgree(l, inc[l], CProp(J))>>
  /\ cq' = [cq EXCEPT ![l] = @ \ {x}]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<histV, alive, inc, term, voted, role, mi, cfgs, pend, rq, kb, agd, rag, rep, spur,
                 cliV, stoV, net, down, opgot>>
\* derives: C3.1 -- node m learns the decided configurations in X it did not know
LearnEv(m, X) == LET E == SortSet(DOMAIN X \ DOMAIN cfgs[m])
                 IN [k \in 1..Len(E) |-> EvCC(m, E[k], X[E[k]], FALSE)]
\* derives: C3.1, C3.4
Merge(m, X) == cfgs[m] @@ X
\* derives: C3.8, F3.3 -- the agreements the receiver has been handed for its pending change
MyAtoms(r) == {a \in kb[r] : pend[r] # NoPend /\ a.j.rcv = r /\ a.j.rinc = inc[r]
                              /\ a.j.rid = pend[r].rid /\ a.j.ep = pend[r].tgt}
\* derives: C3.8, F3.3 -- eligibility in the requested set: re-admitted by an earlier commit
EligNewK(r, q, qi, mem, old) == q \in mem /\ (qi = 0 \/ <<q, qi>> \in Readm(r, old))
\* derives: C3.1, C3.4, C3.8, F3.3 -- the receiver records the agreements and decides once both majorities are eligible
Decide(r) ==
  /\ pend[r] # NoPend /\ alive[r]
  /\ LET p == pend[r]
         old == p.tgt - 1
         new == {[q |-> a.q, qi |-> a.qi] : a \in MyAtoms(r)} \ rag[r]
         R1 == rag[r] \cup new
         P == {<<x.q, x.qi>> : x \in R1}
         knows == old \in DOMAIN cfgs[r]
         okOld == knows /\ MajK(r, P, old)
         okNew == knows /\ 2 * Cardinality({x[1] : x \in {y \in P : EligNewK(r, y[1], y[2], p.mem, old)}})
                            > Cardinality(p.mem)
         ct(q, qi) == (IF knows /\ EligK(r, q, qi, old) THEN {old} ELSE {})
                      \cup (IF knows /\ EligNewK(r, q, qi, p.mem, old) THEN {p.tgt} ELSE {})
         ns == PairSeq({<<x.q, x.qi>> : x \in new})
         agreedEvs == [k \in 1..Len(ns) |-> EvAgreed(r, ns[k][1], ns[k][2],
                          [epoch |-> p.tgt, members |-> p.mem, request_id |-> p.rid], ct(ns[k][1], ns[k][2]))]
         rm == {x \in P : x[2] > 0 /\ x[1] \in p.mem}
         rec == [mem |-> p.mem, rid |-> p.rid, rm |-> rm]
         X == cfgs[r] @@ (p.tgt :> rec)
         reply == [op |-> p.op, rid |-> p.rid, out |-> "committed", ep |-> p.tgt]
         told == {m \in Lease \ {r} : alive[m] /\ Link(r, m)}
         dEv == [EvCC(r, p.tgt, rec, TRUE) EXCEPT !.inputs = 0] @@
                [inputs |-> [agreed |-> P, old_members |-> IF knows THEN MemOf(r, old) ELSE {}, old_epoch |-> old,
                             request_id |-> p.rid, requested_members |-> p.mem]]
         tl == NodeOrder(told)
     IN
     /\ new # {} \/ (okOld /\ okNew)
     /\ IF okOld /\ okNew
        THEN /\ cfgs' = [m \in Lease |-> IF m = r THEN X ELSE IF m \in told THEN Merge(m, X) ELSE cfgs[m]]
             /\ cq' = [m \in Lease |-> IF m \in told \cup {r}
                                       THEN {y \in cq[m] : y.tgt > SetMax(DOMAIN X \cup DOMAIN cfgs[m])}
                                       ELSE cq[m]]
             /\ dc' = dc \cup {[ep |-> p.tgt, mem |-> p.mem, rid |-> p.rid, rm |-> rm, d |-> r, di |-> inc[r]]}
             /\ pend' = [pend EXCEPT ![r] = NoPend]
             /\ rag' = [rag EXCEPT ![r] = {}]
             /\ rep' = [rep EXCEPT ![r] = @ \cup {reply}]
             /\ net' = net \cup Send(r, RCA(r, reply))
             /\ ev' = agreedEvs \o <<dEv>> \o Flat([k \in 1..Len(tl) |-> LearnEv(tl[k], X)])
        ELSE /\ rag' = [rag EXCEPT ![r] = R1]
             /\ ev' = agreedEvs
             /\ UNCHANGED <<cfgs, cq, dc, pend, rep, net>>
  /\ UNCHANGED <<gr, acc, srv, rqs, ldr, lastG, alive, inc, term, voted, role, log, mi, rq, kb, agd, spur,
                 cliV, stoV, down, opgot>>
\* derives: C3.4 -- a receiver that learns the epoch its request would occupy committed elsewhere refuses it
Supersede(r) ==
  /\ pend[r] # NoPend /\ alive[r] /\ pend[r].tgt \in DOMAIN cfgs[r]
  /\ LET p == pend[r]
         reply == [op |-> p.op, rid |-> p.rid, out |-> "superseded", ep |-> p.tgt]
     IN /\ ev' = <<EvRF(r, p.rid, p.mem, "superseded", p.tgt, [commit |-> p.tgt])>>
        /\ pend' = [pend EXCEPT ![r] = NoPend]
        /\ rag' = [rag EXCEPT ![r] = {}]
        /\ rep' = [rep EXCEPT ![r] = @ \cup {reply}]
        /\ net' = net \cup Send(r, RCA(r, reply))
  /\ UNCHANGED <<histV, alive, inc, term, voted, role, log, mi, cfgs, cq, rq, kb, agd, spur,
                 cliV, stoV, down, opgot>>
\* derives: C3.4, F2.1 -- agreements for a receiver: to it, or relayed by one node that reaches it when n does not
RelayAtoms(n, m) == {a \in kb[n] \ kb[m] : a.j.rcv # n /\
                       (m = a.j.rcv \/ (~Link(n, a.j.rcv) /\ Link(m, a.j.rcv)))}
\* derives: C3.1, C3.4 -- n tells m the decided configurations it knows, and relays agreements
Gossip(n, m) ==
  /\ n # m /\ alive[n] /\ alive[m] /\ Link(n, m)
  /\ (DOMAIN cfgs[n] \ DOMAIN cfgs[m] # {} \/ RelayAtoms(n, m) # {})
  /\ LET X == Merge(m, cfgs[n])
     IN /\ cfgs' = [cfgs EXCEPT ![m] = X]
        /\ cq' = [cq EXCEPT ![m] = {y \in @ : y.tgt > SetMax(DOMAIN X)}]
        /\ ev' = LearnEv(m, cfgs[n])
  /\ kb' = [kb EXCEPT ![m] = @ \cup RelayAtoms(n, m)]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<histV, alive, inc, term, voted, role, log, mi, pend, rq, agd, rag, rep, spur,
                 cliV, stoV, net, down, opgot>>
\* derives: C3.4 -- the operator records the outcome, once per request
DeliverRCA(m) ==
  /\ m \in net /\ m.ty = "rca"
  /\ net' = net \ {m}
  /\ IF m.rid \notin opgot[m.op]
     THEN /\ ev' = <<[event |-> "ReconfigAck", proc |-> m.op, operator |-> m.op, request_id |-> m.rid,
                      outcome |-> m.out, epoch |-> m.ep, fr |-> m.fr]>>
          /\ opgot' = [opgot EXCEPT ![m.op] = @ \cup {m.rid}]
     ELSE /\ ev' = <<>> /\ UNCHANGED opgot
  /\ UNCHANGED <<histV, alive, inc, term, voted, role, log, mi, cfgs, pend, cq, rq, kb, agd, rag, rep, spur,
                 cliV, stoV, down>>
\* derives: C3.4, F1.2, F2.1 -- the receiver resends a reply that has not reached its operator
Resend(r, x) ==
  /\ x \in rep[r] /\ alive[r] /\ x.rid \notin opgot[x.op] /\ Link(r, x.op) /\ RCA(r, x) \notin net
  /\ net' = net \cup {RCA(r, x)}
  /\ ev' = <<>>
  /\ UNCHANGED <<histV, alive, inc, term, voted, role, log, mi, cfgs, pend, cq, rq, kb, agd, rag, rep, spur,
                 cliV, stoV, down, opgot>>

(***************************************************************************)
(* Environment: the schedule's steps (cells F1.1 to F3.3, workload)        *)
(***************************************************************************)
\* derives: F1.1, F1.2, F2.1, F3.1 -- Rule A1 for a named process or grantor/holder
Res(x) == CASE x = "grantor" -> snap.g [] x = "holder" -> snap.h [] OTHER -> x
\* derives: F1.1 -- crash p: it stops; messages to it are lost; volatile state goes
CrashEff(p) ==
  /\ alive' = [alive EXCEPT ![p] = FALSE]
  /\ net' = {m \in net : Dest(m) # p}
  /\ IF p \in Lease
     THEN /\ role' = [role EXCEPT ![p] = "F"]
          /\ mi' = [mi EXCEPT ![p] = [m \in Lease |-> [inc |-> 0, len |-> 0]]]
          /\ rq' = [rq EXCEPT ![p] = {}]
          /\ cq' = [cq EXCEPT ![p] = {}]
          /\ kb' = [kb EXCEPT ![p] = {}]
     ELSE UNCHANGED <<role, mi, rq, cq, kb>>
  /\ sout' = IF p = S THEN {} ELSE sout
  /\ paused' = IF p \in Clients THEN [paused EXCEPT ![p] = FALSE] ELSE paused
  /\ UNCHANGED <<inc, term, voted, log, cfgs, pend, agd, rag, rep, ctok, ctoks, creq, ledger, sval>>
\* derives: F1.1 -- ordinary restart: durable state kept; a restarted client has no grant
RestartEff(p) ==
  /\ alive' = [alive EXCEPT ![p] = TRUE]
  /\ IF p \in Clients
     THEN /\ ctok' = [ctok EXCEPT ![p] = NoTok]
          /\ ctoks' = [ctoks EXCEPT ![p] = {}]
          /\ creq' = [creq EXCEPT ![p] = 0]
     ELSE UNCHANGED <<ctok, ctoks, creq>>
  /\ UNCHANGED <<inc, term, voted, role, log, mi, cfgs, pend, cq, rq, kb, agd, rag, rep, paused, ledger, sval, sout, net>>
\* derives: F3.3 -- amnesic restart: a new incarnation that knows only what the deployment gives it
AmnesiaEff(n) ==
  /\ alive' = [alive EXCEPT ![n] = TRUE]
  /\ inc' = [inc EXCEPT ![n] = @ + 1]
  /\ term' = [term EXCEPT ![n] = 0]
  /\ voted' = [voted EXCEPT ![n] = "none"]
  /\ role' = [role EXCEPT ![n] = "F"]
  /\ log' = [log EXCEPT ![n] = <<>>]
  /\ mi' = [mi EXCEPT ![n] = [m \in Lease |-> [inc |-> 0, len |-> 0]]]
  /\ cfgs' = [cfgs EXCEPT ![n] = (0 :> InitRec)]
  /\ pend' = [pend EXCEPT ![n] = NoPend]
  /\ cq' = [cq EXCEPT ![n] = {}]
  /\ rq' = [rq EXCEPT ![n] = {}]
  /\ kb' = [kb EXCEPT ![n] = {}]
  /\ agd' = [agd EXCEPT ![n] = {}]
  /\ rag' = [rag EXCEPT ![n] = {}]
  /\ rep' = [rep EXCEPT ![n] = {}]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<paused, ctok, ctoks, creq, ledger, sval, sout, net>>
\* derives: F1.2, F2.1, F2.2 -- directed links as a Fault record lists them
LinkSeq(P) == LET ps == {p \in P : TRUE} IN ps
\* derives: F1.1, F1.2, F1.3, F2.1, F2.2, F3.1, F3.2, F3.3, C1.1, C1.2, C2.1 -- take step pc's action
DoAct(a) ==
  \/ /\ a.a = "request"
     /\ LET c == Res(a.c) IN
        /\ c \in Clients /\ alive[c] /\ ~paused[c] /\ creq[c] = 0
        /\ creq' = [creq EXCEPT ![c] = pc]
        /\ net' = net \cup UNION {Send(c, [ty |-> "req", c |-> c, rid |-> pc, to |-> n]) : n \in Lease}
        /\ ev' = <<[event |-> "Request", proc |-> c, client |-> c, key |-> KeyName, rid |-> pc]>>
     /\ UNCHANGED <<ngc, histV, alive, inc, term, voted, role, log, mi, cfgs, pend, cq, rq, kb, agd, rag, rep, spur,
                    paused, ctok, ctoks, stoV, down, opgot>>
  \/ /\ a.a \in {"write", "read"}
     /\ LET c == Res(a.c)
            hi == MaxGranted
            st == {t \in ctoks[c] : t.tok < hi}
        IN /\ c \in Clients /\ alive[c] /\ ~paused[c]
           /\ IF a.stale THEN st # {} ELSE ctok[c] # NoTok
           /\ LET t == IF a.stale THEN CHOOSE t \in st : \A u \in st : u.tok <= t.tok ELSE ctok[c]
              IN IF a.a = "write"
                 THEN /\ net' = net \cup Send(c, [ty |-> "w", c |-> c, tok |-> t.tok, gt |-> t.gt, val |-> a.v, id |-> pc])
                      /\ ev' = <<[event |-> "WriteAttempt", proc |-> c, client |-> c, key |-> KeyName, token |-> t.tok,
                                  value |-> a.v, grantor_term |-> t.gt, wid |-> pc]>>
                 ELSE /\ net' = net \cup Send(c, [ty |-> "r", c |-> c, tok |-> t.tok, gt |-> t.gt, id |-> pc])
                      /\ ev' = <<[event |-> "ReadAttempt", proc |-> c, client |-> c, key |-> KeyName, token |-> t.tok,
                                  grantor_term |-> t.gt, xid |-> pc]>>
     /\ UNCHANGED <<ngc, histV, alive, inc, term, voted, role, log, mi, cfgs, pend, cq, rq, kb, agd, rag, rep, spur,
                    cliV, stoV, down, opgot>>
  \/ /\ a.a = "crash"
     /\ \E p \in (IF a.p = "non-grantor" THEN snap.upL \ {snap.g} ELSE {Res(a.p)}) :
          /\ p \in Crashable /\ alive[p]
          /\ CrashEff(p)
          /\ ngc' = IF a.p = "non-grantor" THEN p ELSE ngc
          /\ ev' = <<[event |-> "Fault", proc |-> "env", cell |-> a.cell, crash |-> p]>>
     /\ UNCHANGED <<histV, spur, ctok, ctoks, creq, down, opgot>>
  \/ /\ a.a = "restart"
     /\ LET p == IF a.p = "non-grantor" THEN ngc ELSE Res(a.p) IN
        /\ p \in Crashable /\ ~alive[p]
        /\ RestartEff(p)
        /\ ev' = <<[event |-> "Fault", proc |-> "env", cell |-> a.cell, restart |-> p]>>
     /\ UNCHANGED <<ngc, histV, spur, down, opgot>>
  \/ /\ a.a = "amnesia"
     /\ LET n == IF a.p = "non-grantor" THEN ngc ELSE Res(a.p) IN
        /\ n \in Lease /\ ~alive[n]
        /\ AmnesiaEff(n)
        /\ ev' = <<[event |-> "Fault", proc |-> "env", cell |-> "F3.3", restart |-> n, amnesia |-> TRUE]>>
     /\ UNCHANGED <<ngc, histV, spur, down, opgot>>
  \/ /\ a.a = "partition"
     /\ \E ng \in (snap.upL \ {snap.g}) \cup {"none"} :
          LET R(x) == CASE x = "non-grantor" -> ng [] OTHER -> Res(x)
              A0 == {R(x) : x \in a.s1 \ {"rest"}}
              B0 == {R(x) : x \in a.s2 \ {"rest"}}
              A == IF "rest" \in a.s1 THEN Procs \ B0 ELSE A0
              B == IF "rest" \in a.s2 THEN Procs \ A0 ELSE B0
              L == {<<p, q>> \in (A \X B) \cup (B \X A) : p # q}
          IN /\ (ng = "none") = ("non-grantor" \notin a.s1 \cup a.s2)
             /\ down' = down \cup L
             /\ ev' = <<[event |-> "Fault", proc |-> "env", cell |-> a.cell, partition |-> <<A, B>>, links |-> L]>>
     /\ UNCHANGED <<ngc, histV, alive, inc, term, voted, role, log, mi, cfgs, pend, cq, rq, kb, agd, rag, rep, spur,
                    cliV, stoV, net, opgot>>
  \/ /\ a.a \in {"cut", "drop"}
     /\ \E ng \in (snap.upL \ {snap.g}) \cup {"none"} :
          LET R(x) == CASE x = "non-grantor" -> ng [] OTHER -> Res(x)
              P == {<<R(a.links[i][1]), R(a.links[i][2])>> : i \in 1..Len(a.links)}
              L == {pr \in P : pr[1] # pr[2]} \cup
                   (IF a.a = "cut" THEN {<<pr[2], pr[1]>> : pr \in {pr \in P : pr[1] # pr[2]}} ELSE {})
          IN /\ (ng = "none") = (\A i \in 1..Len(a.links) : "non-grantor" \notin {a.links[i][1], a.links[i][2]})
             /\ down' = down \cup L
             /\ ev' = <<[event |-> "Fault", proc |-> "env", cell |-> a.cell, links |-> L]>>
     /\ UNCHANGED <<ngc, histV, alive, inc, term, voted, role, log, mi, cfgs, pend, cq, rq, kb, agd, rag, rep, spur,
                    cliV, stoV, net, opgot>>
  \/ /\ a.a = "heal"
     /\ down' = {}
     /\ ev' = <<[event |-> "Fault", proc |-> "env", cell |-> a.cell, heal |-> TRUE, links |-> {}]>>
     /\ UNCHANGED <<ngc, histV, alive, inc, term, voted, role, log, mi, cfgs, pend, cq, rq, kb, agd, rag, rep, spur,
                    cliV, stoV, net, opgot>>
  \/ /\ a.a = "pause"
     /\ LET c == Res(a.c) IN
        /\ c \in Clients /\ alive[c] /\ ~paused[c]
        /\ paused' = [paused EXCEPT ![c] = TRUE]
        /\ ev' = <<[event |-> "Fault", proc |-> "env", cell |-> "F1.3", pause |-> c]>>
     /\ UNCHANGED <<ngc, histV, alive, inc, term, voted, role, log, mi, cfgs, pend, cq, rq, kb, agd, rag, rep, spur,
                    ctok, ctoks, creq, stoV, net, down, opgot>>
  \/ /\ a.a = "resume"
     /\ LET c == Res(a.c) IN
        /\ c \in Clients /\ paused[c]
        /\ paused' = [paused EXCEPT ![c] = FALSE]
        /\ ev' = <<[event |-> "Fault", proc |-> "env", cell |-> "F1.3", resume |-> c]>>
     /\ UNCHANGED <<ngc, histV, alive, inc, term, voted, role, log, mi, cfgs, pend, cq, rq, kb, agd, rag, rep, spur,
                    ctok, ctoks, creq, stoV, net, down, opgot>>
  \/ /\ a.a = "reconf"
     /\ \E to \in (CASE a.to = "non-grantor" -> snap.upL \ {snap.g}
                     [] a.to = "non-member" -> snap.nm
                     [] OTHER -> {Res(a.to)}) :
          /\ to \in Lease
          /\ net' = net \cup Send(a.op, [ty |-> "rc", op |-> a.op, rid |-> a.rid, mem |-> a.mem, to |-> to])
          /\ ev' = <<[event |-> "ReconfigSend", proc |-> a.op, operator |-> a.op, request_id |-> a.rid,
                      to |-> to, members |-> a.mem]>>
     /\ rqs' = rqs \cup {[rid |-> a.rid, mem |-> a.mem]}
     /\ UNCHANGED <<ngc, gr, dc, acc, srv, ldr, lastG, alive, inc, term, voted, role, log, mi, cfgs, pend, cq, rq, kb,
                    agd, rag, rep, spur, cliV, stoV, down, opgot>>
  \/ /\ a.a = "clock"
     /\ LET p == IF a.p = "non-grantor" THEN ngc ELSE Res(a.p) IN
        /\ p \in Procs
        /\ ev' = <<[event |-> "Fault", proc |-> "env", cell |-> "F3.2", clock |-> p, step |-> a.step]>>
     /\ UNCHANGED <<ngc, histV, alive, inc, term, voted, role, log, mi, cfgs, pend, cq, rq, kb, agd, rag, rep, spur,
                    cliV, stoV, net, down, opgot>>
\* derives: F1.1 -- Rules T1, T2: take the action of the fired step; arm (and maybe fire) the next trigger
Take ==
  /\ fired /\ pc <= NSteps
  /\ DoAct(Steps[pc].do)
  /\ pc' = pc + 1
  /\ IF TrigAt(pc + 1).kind = "start" \/ Hit(TrigAt(pc + 1), ev')
     THEN fired' = TRUE /\ snap' = SnapOf(lastG', alive', dc')
     ELSE fired' = FALSE /\ snap' = snap

(* Next state                                                              *)

\* derives: F1.1 -- a protocol step: the schedule position stays, the armed trigger may fire
Sys(A) == A /\ Obs /\ UNCHANGED <<pc, ngc>>
\* derives: C1.1, C1.2, C1.3, C1.4, C2.1, C2.2, C3.1, C3.4, C3.5, C3.7, C3.8
Protocol ==
  \/ \E n \in Lease : Sys(TimeoutNeeded(n)) \/ Sys(TimeoutSpur(n)) \/ Sys(StepDown(n))
                      \/ Sys(Decide(n)) \/ Sys(Supersede(n))
                      \/ \E Q \in SUBSET Lease : Sys(Win(n, Q))
  \/ \E n, m \in Lease : Sys(AE(n, m)) \/ Sys(TermProp(n, m)) \/ Sys(Gossip(n, m))
  \/ \E n, m \in Lease : \E x \in rq[n] : Sys(Forward(n, m, x))
  \/ \E n, m \in Lease : \E x \in Items(n) : Sys(FwdCfg(n, m, x))
  \/ \E n \in Lease : \E x \in rq[n] : Sys(ProposeQ(n, x))
  \/ \E n \in Lease : \E x \in Items(n) : Sys(ProposeCfg(n, x))
  \/ \E n \in Lease : \E x \in rep[n] : Sys(Resend(n, x))
  \/ \E m \in net : Sys(DeliverReq(m)) \/ Sys(DeliverGM(m)) \/ Sys(DeliverW(m)) \/ Sys(DeliverR(m))
                    \/ Sys(DeliverWA(m)) \/ Sys(DeliverRA(m)) \/ Sys(DeliverRC(m)) \/ Sys(DeliverRCA(m))
  \/ \E o \in sout : Sys(SendOut(o))
  \/ \E c \in Clients : Sys(Retransmit(c))
\* derives: C1.1, C1.2, C1.3, C1.4, C2.1, C2.2, C3.1, C3.4, C3.5, C3.7, C3.8, F1.1, F1.2, F1.3, F2.1, F2.2, F3.1, F3.2, F3.3
Next == Take \/ Protocol
\* derives: C1.1, C1.2, C1.3, C2.1, C2.2, C3.1, C3.5, C3.7, C3.8 -- safety is checked on every behaviour
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

(***************************************************************************)
(* End of a run (Rule E1)                                                  *)
(***************************************************************************)
\* derives: C1.4, C3.4 -- quiescent: nothing in flight, nobody waiting, nothing pending at an up receiver
Quiescent ==
  /\ pc > NSteps
  /\ \A m \in net : ~(Up(Dest(m)) /\ ~(Dest(m) \in Clients /\ paused[Dest(m)]))
  /\ (alive[S] => sout = {})
  /\ \A c \in Clients : (alive[c] /\ ~paused[c]) => creq[c] = 0
  /\ \A n \in Lease : alive[n] => pend[n] = NoPend
\* derives: C1.4, C3.4
EndReached == pc > NSteps /\ IF EndT.kind = "quiescent" THEN Quiescent ELSE fired
\* derives: C1.4, C3.4 -- violated exactly when a run reaches its end (used to export a witness trace)
NotEnded == ~EndReached

(***************************************************************************)
(* Safety invariants (checked on every state of every behaviour)           *)
(***************************************************************************)
\* derives: C1.1 -- (a) no two grants carry one token; (b) a higher epoch carries a higher token
C1_1_Tokens ==
  /\ \A g, h \in gr : g # h => g.tok # h.tok
  /\ \A g, h \in gr : g.ep < h.ep => g.tok < h.tok
\* derives: C1.1 -- (c) in every log, decided grants appear in increasing token order (a node agrees in log order)
C1_1_AgreeOrder ==
  \A n \in Lease : \A i, j \in 1..Len(log[n]) :
     (i < j /\ log[n][i].k = "g" /\ log[n][j].k = "g"
      /\ (\E r \in gr : r.tok = log[n][i].tok /\ r.term = log[n][i].t)
      /\ (\E r \in gr : r.tok = log[n][j].tok /\ r.term = log[n][j].t)) => log[n][i].tok < log[n][j].tok
\* derives: C1.1 -- grants carrying one term were decided by one incarnation of one node; one leader per term
C1_1_Terms ==
  /\ \A g, h \in gr : g.term = h.term => (g.d = h.d /\ g.di = h.di)
  /\ \A a, b \in ldr : a.t = b.t => a = b
\* derives: C1.2 -- storage accepts a write iff token >= ledger, and the ledger becomes that token
C1_2 == \A k \in 1..Len(ev) :
          /\ ev[k].event = "WriteAccept" => (ev[k].token >= ev[k].highest_before /\ ledger = ev[k].token)
          /\ ev[k].event = "WriteReject" => (ev[k].token < ev[k].highest_before /\ ledger = ev[k].highest_before)
\* derives: C1.3 -- a client is told success only for a write storage accepted
C1_3 == \A k \in 1..Len(ev) : (ev[k].event = "WriteAck" /\ ev[k].outcome = "accepted") => ev[k].wid \in acc
\* derives: C2.1 -- storage serves a read only if token >= ledger; serving does not move the ledger
C2_1 == \A k \in 1..Len(ev) :
          /\ ev[k].event = "ReadAccept" => (ev[k].token >= ev[k].highest_before /\ ledger = ev[k].highest_before)
          /\ ev[k].event = "ReadReject" => ev[k].token < ev[k].highest_before
\* derives: C2.2 -- a client is given only a value storage served for that read
C2_2 == \A k \in 1..Len(ev) :
          (ev[k].event = "ReadAck" /\ ev[k].outcome = "served") => [id |-> ev[k].xid, val |-> ev[k].value] \in srv
\* derives: C3.1 -- at most one configuration per epoch; e+1 only after e
C3_1 == /\ \A a, b \in dc : a.ep = b.ep => a = b
        /\ \A a \in dc : a.ep > 0 => \E b \in dc : b.ep = a.ep - 1
\* derives: C3.7 -- a grant: its decider's current configuration, recorded, counted by an eligible majority of it
C3_7 == \A k \in 1..Len(ev) : ev[k].event = "Grant" =>
          LET g == ev[k] IN
          /\ g.inputs.config_epoch = g.config_epoch
          /\ g.config_epoch = Cur(g.proc)
          /\ \E x \in dc : x.ep = g.config_epoch /\ x.mem = g.inputs.members
          /\ 2 * Cardinality({p[1] : p \in {y \in g.inputs.agreed : GElig(y[1], y[2], g.config_epoch)}})
               > Cardinality(GMem(g.config_epoch))
\* derives: C3.8 -- a commit: eligible majorities of e and of e+1, members those of its request; success told only after it
C3_8 == \A k \in 1..Len(ev) :
          /\ (ev[k].event = "ConfigCommitted" /\ ev[k].decided) =>
               LET c == ev[k]
                   e == c.epoch - 1
                   P == c.inputs.agreed
               IN /\ \E x \in dc : x.ep = e /\ x.mem = c.inputs.old_members
                  /\ 2 * Cardinality({p[1] : p \in {y \in P : GElig(y[1], y[2], e)}}) > Cardinality(GMem(e))
                  /\ 2 * Cardinality({p[1] : p \in {y \in P : y[1] \in c.members /\ (y[2] = 0 \/ y \in GReadm(e))}})
                       > Cardinality(c.members)
                  /\ \E r \in rqs : r.rid = c.request_id /\ r.mem = c.members
          /\ (ev[k].event = "ReconfigAck" /\ ev[k].outcome = "committed") =>
               \E x \in dc : x.rid = ev[k].request_id /\ x.ep = ev[k].epoch
\* derives: C3.5 -- every decision is the fixed function of its recorded inputs
C3_5 == \A k \in 1..Len(ev) :
          LET e == ev[k] IN
          /\ e.event \in {"WriteAccept", "WriteReject"} =>
               /\ (e.event = "WriteAccept") = (e.inputs.token >= e.inputs.ledger)
               /\ e.token = e.inputs.token /\ e.highest_before = e.inputs.ledger
          /\ e.event \in {"ReadAccept", "ReadReject"} =>
               /\ (e.event = "ReadAccept") = (e.inputs.token >= e.inputs.ledger)
               /\ e.token = e.inputs.token /\ e.highest_before = e.inputs.ledger
               /\ e.event = "ReadAccept" => e.value = e.inputs.stored_value
          /\ e.event = "Grant" =>
               /\ e.token = e.inputs.last_token + 1 /\ e.config_epoch = e.inputs.config_epoch
               /\ e.grantor_term = e.inputs.grantor_term
          /\ (e.event = "ConfigCommitted" /\ e.decided) =>
               /\ e.epoch = e.inputs.old_epoch + 1 /\ e.members = e.inputs.requested_members
               /\ e.readmits = {p \in e.inputs.agreed : p[2] > 0 /\ p[1] \in e.members}
          /\ e.event = "ReconfigRefused" =>
               e.reason = (IF e.inputs.requested_members = {} \/ ~(e.inputs.requested_members \subseteq Lease)
                           THEN "invalid"
                           ELSE IF "pending" \in DOMAIN e.inputs THEN "busy" ELSE "superseded")

(***************************************************************************)
(* Liveness (C1.4, C3.4), read after the last fault (Rule L3, extended)    *)
(***************************************************************************)
\* derives: C1.4, C3.4 -- after the last fault of the schedule
LF == pc > LastFault
\* derives: C1.4, F3.3 -- eligible in the globally committed configuration (its latest incarnation)
EligG(q) == GElig(q, inc[q], GCur)
\* derives: C1.4 -- the premise for requester c
Prem14(c) ==
  /\ LF /\ alive[c] /\ ~paused[c] /\ alive[S]
  /\ \A n \in Lease : alive[n] => pend[n] = NoPend
  /\ \E M \in SUBSET {q \in GMem(GCur) : alive[q] /\ EligG(q)} :
       2 * Cardinality(M) > Cardinality(GMem(GCur)) /\ ConnSet(M \cup {S, c})
\* derives: C1.4 -- if the premise holds, a requester eventually obtains a grant
C1_4 == \A c \in Clients : (Prem14(c) /\ creq[c] # 0) ~> (creq[c] = 0 \/ ~Prem14(c))
\* derives: C3.4 -- receivers holding request r
PendAt(r) == {n \in Lease : pend[n] # NoPend /\ pend[n].rid = r}
\* derives: C3.4, F3.3 -- eligible in the requested set: incarnation 0 or re-admitted
EligNewG(q) == inc[q] = 0 \/ <<q, inc[q]>> \in GReadm(GCur)
\* derives: C3.4 -- C3.4(b)'s premise for request r
Prem34(r) ==
  /\ LF
  /\ \E n \in PendAt(r) :
       /\ alive[n]
       /\ \E M1 \in SUBSET {q \in GMem(GCur) : alive[q] /\ EligG(q)} :
          \E M2 \in SUBSET {q \in pend[n].mem : alive[q] /\ EligNewG(q)} :
            /\ 2 * Cardinality(M1) > Cardinality(GMem(GCur))
            /\ 2 * Cardinality(M2) > Cardinality(pend[n].mem)
            /\ ConnSet(M1 \cup M2 \cup {n})
\* derives: C3.4 -- (b): eventually committed or refused as superseded
C3_4_Resolved == \A r \in ReqIds : (Prem34(r) /\ PendAt(r) # {}) ~> (PendAt(r) = {} \/ ~Prem34(r))
\* derives: C3.4 -- the receiver has an outcome for r and is connected to r's operator
Replied(r) == \E n \in Lease : alive[n] /\ \E x \in rep[n] : x.rid = r /\ Conn(n, x.op)
\* derives: C3.4 -- every operator told the outcome if it stays connected to the receiver
Told(r) == \E o \in Ops : r \in opgot[o]
\* derives: C3.4
C3_4_Told == \A r \in ReqIds : (LF /\ Replied(r) /\ ~Told(r)) ~> (Told(r) \/ ~Replied(r))

\* derives: C1.4, C3.4 -- fairness, each on an action enabled by the actor's own state and links that are up (README)
Fairness ==
  /\ WF_vars(Take)
  /\ \A n \in Lease :
       /\ WF_vars(Sys(TimeoutNeeded(n)))
       /\ WF_vars(\E Q \in SUBSET Lease : Sys(Win(n, Q)))
       /\ WF_vars(Sys(StepDown(n)))
       /\ WF_vars(Sys(Decide(n)))
       /\ WF_vars(Sys(Supersede(n)))
       /\ WF_vars(\E x \in rq[n] : Sys(ProposeQ(n, x)))
       /\ WF_vars(\E x \in Items(n) : Sys(ProposeCfg(n, x)))
       /\ WF_vars(\E x \in rep[n] : Sys(Resend(n, x)))
  /\ \A n, m \in Lease :
       /\ WF_vars(Sys(AE(n, m)))
       /\ WF_vars(Sys(TermProp(n, m)))
       /\ WF_vars(Sys(Gossip(n, m)))
       /\ WF_vars(\E x \in rq[n] : Sys(Forward(n, m, x)))
       /\ WF_vars(\E x \in Items(n) : Sys(FwdCfg(n, m, x)))
  /\ \A p \in Procs : WF_vars(\E m \in net : Dest(m) = p /\
                         (Sys(DeliverReq(m)) \/ Sys(DeliverGM(m)) \/ Sys(DeliverW(m)) \/ Sys(DeliverR(m))
                          \/ Sys(DeliverWA(m)) \/ Sys(DeliverRA(m)) \/ Sys(DeliverRC(m)) \/ Sys(DeliverRCA(m))))
  /\ WF_vars(\E o \in sout : Sys(SendOut(o)))
  /\ \A c \in Clients : WF_vars(Sys(Retransmit(c)))
\* derives: C1.4, C3.4 -- the specification liveness is checked against
LiveSpec == Spec /\ Fairness
=============================================================================

input.command:
pgrep -f "[t]lc2.TLC" | xargs -r kill; cd /home/tupay-author/projects/tupay-x3-regen-model/model-regen && python3 - <<'EOF'
p='Lease.tla'
s=open(p).read()
old='''\\* derives: C1.4, C3.4 -- fairness, each on an action enabled by the actor's own state and links that are up (README)'''
new='''\\* derives: C1.4 -- an unmet C1.4 obligation: the premise holds for a requester
Owed14 == \\E c \\in Clients : Prem14(c) /\\ creq[c] # 0
\\* derives: C3.4 -- an unmet C3.4(b) obligation
Owed34 == \\E r \\in ReqIds : Prem34(r) /\\ PendAt(r) # {}
\\* derives: C3.4 -- an unmet duty to tell an operator
OwedTold == \\E r \\in ReqIds : LF /\\ Replied(r) /\\ ~Told(r)
\\* derives: C1.1, C1.4 -- a stall the TLC term bound may cause (reported as UNEXPLAINED bound, never PASS or FAIL)
BoundStall == \\E n \\in Lease : term[n] >= MaxTerm
\\* derives: C1.4 -- liveness, terminal form: no reachable state where nothing can happen leaves an obligation unmet.
\\* Every action changes the state monotonically (terms, logs, knowledge, schedule position), so the reachable graph
\\* has no cycle and every behaviour ends in such a terminal state; there, weak fairness of every action is vacuous,
\\* and "eventually" holds iff it holds at the end (README, Liveness).
C1_4_Terminal == Owed14 => (ENABLED Next \\/ BoundStall)
\\* derives: C3.4
C3_4_Terminal == (Owed34 \\/ OwedTold) => (ENABLED Next \\/ BoundStall)
\\* derives: C1.4, C3.4 -- a terminal state with an unmet obligation, at the term bound
NoBoundStall == (Owed14 \\/ Owed34 \\/ OwedTold) => (ENABLED Next \\/ ~BoundStall)

\\* derives: C1.4, C3.4 -- fairness, each on an action enabled by the actor's own state and links that are up (README)'''
assert old in s; s=s.replace(old,new)
open(p,'w').write(s)
p='compile.py'
s=open(p).read()
old="""    inv = ['C1_1_Tokens', 'C1_1_AgreeOrder', 'C1_1_Terms', 'C3_1']"""
new="""    inv = ['C1_1_Tokens', 'C1_1_AgreeOrder', 'C1_1_Terms', 'C3_1', 'C1_4_Terminal'] + \\
        (['C3_4_Terminal'] if const['ReqIds'] else []) + ['NoBoundStall']"""
assert old in s; s=s.replace(old,new)
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Model-side runner: one schedule (or all, or the mutations) through TLC, to a verdict and an observe file.

derives: C1.1, C1.2, C1.3, C1.4, C2.1, C2.2, C3.1, C3.4, C3.5, C3.7, C3.8, F1.1, F1.2, F1.3, F2.1, F2.2, F3.1, F3.2,
F3.3 (it runs every invariant and both liveness clauses on every compiled schedule, and the decision-replay check)

usage: run.py <schedule-name> [--mutation P<n>] [--max-term N] [--spur N] [--sims K]
       run.py --all [--sims K]           every testbed/schedules/*.yaml
       run.py --mutations [P<n> ...]     every pair's mutant on its pair's shared schedule
Prints one line per run: PASS, FAIL <clause>, or UNEXPLAINED <reason>.
"""
import glob
import json
import os
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import time

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
ROOT = os.path.dirname(HERE)
sys.path.insert(0, HERE)
import compile as C  # noqa: E402
import export as X  # noqa: E402
import yaml  # noqa: E402

TLA = os.environ.get('TLA2TOOLS', '/opt/tlaplus/tla2tools.jar')
HEAP = os.environ.get('TLC_HEAP', '10g')
WORKERS = os.environ.get('TLC_WORKERS', '48')
TIMEOUT = int(os.environ.get('TLC_TIMEOUT', '5400'))
BUILD = os.path.join(ROOT, 'tmp', 'model-regen')
RESULTS = os.path.join(HERE, 'results')

# derives: C1.1, C1.2, C1.3, C2.1, C2.2, C3.1, C3.5, C3.7, C3.8 -- which clause each checked name enforces
CLAUSE = {'C1_1_Tokens': 'C1.1', 'C1_1_AgreeOrder': 'C1.1', 'C1_1_Terms': 'C1.1', 'C3_1': 'C3.1',
          'C1_2_Step': 'C1.2', 'C1_3_Step': 'C1.3', 'C2_1_Step': 'C2.1', 'C2_2_Step': 'C2.2',
          'C3_7_Step': 'C3.7', 'C3_8_Step': 'C3.8', 'C3_5_Step': 'C3.5'}


def tlc(dirpath, cfg, out, extra=(), workers=None, timeout=None):
    """derives: C1.1, C1.4 -- run TLC; returns (text, seconds, timed_out)"""
    shutil.rmtree(os.path.join(dirpath, 'states'), ignore_errors=True)
    cmd = ['java', '-XX:+UseParallelGC', f'-Xmx{HEAP}', '-cp', TLA, 'tlc2.TLC', '-workers', str(workers or WORKERS),
           '-nowarning', '-config', cfg] + list(extra) + ['MC']
    t0 = time.time()
    timed_out = False
    with open(os.path.join(dirpath, out), 'w') as f:
        try:
            subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=dirpath, stdout=f, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, timeout=timeout or TIMEOUT)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            timed_out = True
    shutil.rmtree(os.path.join(dirpath, 'states'), ignore_errors=True)
    return open(os.path.join(dirpath, out)).read(), time.time() - t0, timed_out


def stats(text):
    """derives: C1.1 -- states explored and depth"""
    m = re.findall(r'([\d,]+) states generated, ([\d,]+) distinct states found', text)
    d = re.findall(r'The depth of the complete state graph search is (\d+)', text)
    out = {}
    if m:
        out['generated'] = int(m[-1][0].replace(',', ''))
        out['distinct'] = int(m[-1][1].replace(',', ''))
    if d:
        out['depth'] = int(d[-1])
    return out


def final_state_formula(text):
    """derives: C1.4, C3.4 -- the last state of TLC's error trace, as a TLA+ formula"""
    blocks = re.split(r'\nState \d+: [^\n]*\n', text)
    last = blocks[-1]
    lines = []
    for ln in last.splitlines():
        if ln.startswith('/\\ ') or (lines and ln.startswith(' ')):
            lines.append(ln)
        elif lines:
            break
    return '\n'.join(lines)


def classify_stuck(d, module, text):
    """derives: C1.4, C3.4 -- which obligation a terminal state leaves unmet (TLC evaluates it on that state)"""
    st = final_state_formula(text)
    mc = open(os.path.join(d, 'MC.tla')).read().replace('---- MODULE MC ----', '---- MODULE Probe ----')
    mc = mc.replace('====', f'ProbeInit ==\n{st}\nProbeNext == UNCHANGED vars\n====')
    open(os.path.join(d, 'Probe.tla'), 'w').write(mc)
    cfg = open(os.path.join(d, 'safety.cfg')).read().split('SPECIFICATION')[0].replace('VIEW View\n', '')
    cfg = cfg.replace('CHECK_DEADLOCK TRUE', 'CHECK_DEADLOCK FALSE')
    res = {}
    for name in ('Stuck14', 'Stuck34', 'StuckBound'):
        open(os.path.join(d, 'probe.cfg'), 'w').write(cfg + f'INIT ProbeInit\nNEXT ProbeNext\nINVARIANT Not{name}\n')
        mc2 = open(os.path.join(d, 'Probe.tla')).read()
        if f'Not{name} ==' not in mc2:
            mc2 = mc2.replace('ProbeNext ==', f'Not{name} == ~{name}\nProbeNext ==')
            open(os.path.join(d, 'Probe.tla'), 'w').write(mc2)
        shutil.rmtree(os.path.join(d, 'states'), ignore_errors=True)
        r = subprocess.run(['java', '-cp', TLA, 'tlc2.TLC', '-workers', '1', '-nowarning', '-config', 'probe.cfg',
                            'Probe'], cwd=d, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=600)
        res[name] = 'is violated' in r.stdout
        if 'rror' in r.stdout and 'is violated' not in r.stdout:
            res[name + '_err'] = r.stdout[-2000:]
    shutil.rmtree(os.path.join(d, 'states'), ignore_errors=True)
    if res.get('StuckBound'):
        return 'UNEXPLAINED bound'
    if res.get('Stuck14'):
        return 'FAIL C1.4'
    if res.get('Stuck34'):
        return 'FAIL C3.4'
    return 'UNEXPLAINED terminal-state classification'


def replay(paths, extra_inputs=None):
    """derives: C3.5, C3.7, C3.8, C3.1, C1.1 -- the steward's decision-replay check over the given traces"""
    cmd = [sys.executable, os.path.join(ROOT, 'observe', 'decision_replay.py')]
    if extra_inputs:
        cmd += ['--extra-inputs', extra_inputs]
    r = subprocess.run(cmd + paths, capture_output=True, text=True)
    return r.returncode, r.stdout


def replay_clause(report):
    """derives: C3.5 -- the clause a decision-replay report names (C3.5 for unequal outcomes on equal inputs)"""
    for ln in report.splitlines():
        if ln.startswith('UNEXPLAINED inputs'):
            return 'C3.5'
    for ln in report.splitlines():
        m = re.search(r'\((C\d\.\d)\)', ln)
        if m:
            return m.group(1)
    return 'C3.5'


def write_jsonl(recs, path):
    """derives: C3.5"""
    with open(path, 'w') as f:
        for r in recs:
            r = dict(r)
            r.pop('_state', None)
            f.write(json.dumps(r) + '\n')


def run_one(name, mutation=None, max_term=None, spur=None, sims=None, quiet=False):
    """derives: C1.1, C1.2, C1.3, C1.4, C2.1, C2.2, C3.1, C3.4, C3.5, C3.7, C3.8 -- one schedule, one verdict"""
    ypath = os.path.join(ROOT, 'testbed', 'schedules', f'{name}.yaml')
    if not os.path.exists(ypath):
        return {'name': name, 'verdict': f'UNEXPLAINED no schedule testbed/schedules/{name}.yaml'}
    sched = yaml.safe_load(open(ypath))
    run_id = sched.get('schedule', name)
    tag = name + (f'.mut-{mutation}' if mutation else '')
    d = os.path.join(BUILD, tag)
    shutil.rmtree(d, ignore_errors=True)
    os.makedirs(d)
    module = 'Lease'
    src = os.path.join(HERE, 'Lease.tla')
    if mutation:
        module = f'Lease_{mutation}'
        src = os.path.join(HERE, 'mutations', f'{module}.tla')
    shutil.copy(src, os.path.join(d, f'{module}.tla'))
    if mutation:   # a mutant extends nothing else; its MC extends the mutant module
        pass
    try:
        const, meta = C.compile_schedule(sched, max_term, spur)
    except C.Reject as e:
        return {'name': name, 'verdict': f'UNEXPLAINED rejected {e}'}
    C.write_outputs(const, meta, d, module)
    res = {'name': name, 'run': run_id, 'mutation': mutation, 'max_term': meta['max_term'], 'spur': meta['spur'],
           'meta': meta}
    out_dir = os.path.join(RESULTS, 'mutations' if mutation else 'schedules', tag)
    os.makedirs(out_dir, exist_ok=True)

    # 1. safety and liveness (terminal form) in one breadth-first run
    text, secs, to = tlc(d, 'safety.cfg', 'safety.out')
    res['safety'] = {'seconds': round(secs, 1), **stats(text)}
    verdict = None
    trace_text = None
    if to:
        verdict = 'UNEXPLAINED bound (TLC time limit; no violation in the part explored)'
    else:
        m = re.search(r'Error: (?:Invariant|Action property) (\w+) is violated', text)
        if m:
            verdict = f'FAIL {CLAUSE.get(m.group(1), m.group(1))}'
            res['violated'] = m.group(1)
            trace_text = text
        elif 'Deadlock reached' in text:
            verdict = classify_stuck(d, module, text)
            res['violated'] = 'terminal state with an unmet obligation'
            trace_text = text
        elif 'Model checking completed. No error has been found.' not in text:
            verdict = 'UNEXPLAINED model-error'
            res['tlc_tail'] = text[-3000:]
    traces = []
    observe_path = os.path.join(ROOT, 'observe', f'{run_id}.jsonl')
    if trace_text:
        states, loop = X.parse_trace(trace_text)
        recs = X.export(states, run_id, meta, loop)
        write_jsonl(recs, observe_path)
        shutil.copy(observe_path, os.path.join(out_dir, 'counterexample.jsonl'))
        traces.append(observe_path)

    # 2. a witness: the shortest behaviour that reaches the schedule's end
    if verdict is None or verdict.startswith('UNEXPLAINED bound (TLC'):
        wtext, wsecs, wto = tlc(d, 'witness.cfg', 'witness.out')
        res['witness'] = {'seconds': round(wsecs, 1), **stats(wtext)}
        if 'Invariant NotEnded is violated' in wtext:
            states, loop = X.parse_trace(wtext)
            recs = X.export(states, run_id, meta, loop)
            write_jsonl(recs, observe_path)
            shutil.copy(observe_path, os.path.join(out_dir, 'witness.jsonl'))
            traces.append(observe_path)
            res['witness']['length'] = len(states)
        elif verdict is None:
            verdict = 'UNEXPLAINED end unreachable' if not wto else 'UNEXPLAINED bound (witness search time limit)'

    # 3. more behaviours to the end, sampled at random, for C3.5 across runs
    nsims = int(os.environ.get('MODEL_SIMS', '8')) if sims is None else sims
    sim_paths = []
    if verdict is None and nsims > 0:
        for k in range(nsims):
            stext, _, _ = tlc(d, 'witness.cfg', f'sim{k}.out', ['-simulate', '-depth', '400', '-seed', str(1000 + k)],
                              workers=1, timeout=300)
            if 'Invariant NotEnded is violated' in stext:
                states, loop = X.parse_trace(stext)
                recs = X.export(states, run_id, meta, loop)
                p = os.path.join(out_dir, f'sim{k}.jsonl')
                write_jsonl(recs, p)
                sim_paths.append(p)
        res['sims'] = len(sim_paths)

    # 4. the steward's decision-replay check on every exported trace of this run
    rc, rep = replay(traces + sim_paths)
    res['replay'] = rep.strip().splitlines()[-1] if rep.strip() else ''
    open(os.path.join(out_dir, 'replay.txt'), 'w').write(rep)
    if verdict is None and rc != 0:
        verdict = f'FAIL {replay_clause(rep)}'
        res['replay_report'] = rep.splitlines()[:20]
    if verdict is None:
        verdict = 'PASS'
    res['verdict'] = verdict
    for f in ('safety.out', 'witness.out'):
        p = os.path.join(d, f)
        if os.path.exists(p):
            t = open(p).read()
            open(os.path.join(out_dir, f.replace('.out', '.tlc.txt')), 'w').write(t[-200000:])
    json.dump(res, open(os.path.join(out_dir, 'result.json'), 'w'), indent=1, default=str)
    return res


def mutation_pairs():
    """derives: C1.1, C1.2, C1.3, C1.4, C2.1, C2.2, C3.1, C3.4, C3.5, C3.7, C3.8 -- pair -> schedule"""
    out = []
    for p in sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(HERE, 'mutations', 'Lease_P*.tla')),
                    key=lambda x: int(re.search(r'P(\d+)', x).group(1))):
        out.append(re.search(r'Lease_(P\d+)\.tla', p).group(1))
    return out


def main(argv):
    args = list(argv)
    opts = {}
    for flag in ('--max-term', '--spur', '--sims', '--mutation'):
        if flag in args:
            k = args.index(flag)
            opts[flag] = args[k + 1]
            del args[k:k + 2]
    mt = int(opts['--max-term']) if '--max-term' in opts else None
    sp = int(opts['--spur']) if '--spur' in opts else None
    sims = int(opts['--sims']) if '--sims' in opts else None
    if not args:
        print(__doc__)
        return 2
    if args[0] == '--all':
        names = sorted(os.path.basename(p)[:-5] for p in glob.glob(os.path.join(ROOT, 'testbed', 'schedules', '*.yaml')))
        rows = []
        for n in names:
            r = run_one(n, None, mt, sp, sims)
            rows.append(r)
